DR. ALFREDO GUTIERREZ, JR., MAYOR
CITY OF DEL RIO
P. G. DRAWER D D DEL RID, TEXAS 78840
April 27, 1976
J. L. Johnson, P. E.
Acting Chief, Engineering Division
Corps of Engineers
P. O. Box 17300
Fort Worth, Texas 76102
Dear Mr. Johnson:
In response to your letter of April 22nd, I am not aware of any conflict in land-use patterns or any adverse environmental impact which would result from the installation of hydroelectic generators in Amistad Dam.
If any adverse impact should come to my attention I will promptly communicate it to you.
Sincerely,
Dr. Alfredo Gutierrez, Jr. Mayor
